titular: The night with the most damage (**244k** avg DPS, the highest of the three), but the best attempt only reached **61.2%**: 114 deaths ate that damage. 1802880 was the top killer (11 deaths) and the zones Rahu summons added another 50.

recomendaciones.titulo: What separates this night from the kills.
recomendaciones.texto: Compared with the two runs where Rahu died (Nov 7 at 01:38 and 02:45): this night’s attempts lasted **144 s** on average, the shortest of all (269–304 s in the kills), and each player’s first death came between **92 and 131 s** (127–223 s in the kills). There were **2.6 deaths per minute** versus 1.9–2.0, and the stagger broke in 9 of 18 attempts versus all of them. It was the night with the most damage (244k versus the kill group’s 198k) and the one that held out the least: damage without survival doesn’t progress.

It is a single-target hit of up to 194k that one-shots. It comes around 26–35 s and again around 119–130 s. Tonight it killed 11 players, 5 of them Rhygal. Figure out who it targets (second on aggro? closest?) and call it on voice when it comes.

recomendaciones.titulo: Get out of the zones in time.
recomendaciones.texto: 50 deaths came from the zones Rahu summons (invisible damage areas, not enemies): 2920725 (17 deaths), 2920717 (1802830, 11), 2920718 (1802850, 10) and 2920724 (1802920, 6). There is damage to spare: if nobody stays inside, the boss goes down.
Attempts without a break didn’t pass 39.5%, and every attempt that reached 48% or more had one (between 102 and 148 s). Same as the other nights: no break, no progress.
6 attempts died between 36 and 50% (zone phase, 115–175 s) and another 6 between 51 and 61%, when Rahu casts 1802860 and 1802720 (154–228 s). Secure the first wall first; the second is the next goal.
The last attempt had the night’s lowest group DPS (169k) and ended at 19.5%. With the run limit close, a tired attempt adds little; better to wrap up with a talk about what to change.

FunPeople: Top DPS (52.3k, peaks of 63–65k) and the fewest deaths (15). A very good night.
6 of your 15 deaths are from 2920725, at the end of wipes, when you’re the last one up. What needs fixing is what kills the others first.
In the last attempt you dropped to 30k: fatigue counts too.
Rhygal: 49.1k DPS with 75.5% of hits from behind.
1802880 killed you 5 times and is what hurts you most (723k, 145k hits). It seems to target you often: when it’s cast around 26–35 s or 119–130 s, use a defensive or get out of range.
Izumi: Your good attempts are excellent (57–69k DPS), but you die the most (30) and the earliest: first death at 92 s on average, and 7 deaths before the 60-second mark.
2920717 (1802830) killed you 5 times; it appears around 45–100 s. Leave that zone as soon as you see it.
1802880 killed you 3 times with 121k hits. If it targets the farthest player or casters, keep a shield for that moment.
Garretin: First death at 108 s on average. 2920718 (1802850) killed you 4 times, and 5 deaths came from Rahu with no recorded ability (probably damage over time).
You have the lowest CP in the group (175k): upgrading gear is the most direct improvement.
Cry: 43.9k DPS and 5.1k HPS. No deaths before the 60-second mark: good handling of the opening.
4 of your deaths are from 2920725 at the end of wipes, and your first death comes at 131 s on average, already in the zone phase. The group’s healing depends on you there: prioritize surviving.
1802715 and 1802710 take about 820k from you in small hits. A pre-emptive group heal before 115 s buys margin for the hard phase.

notas.texto: Izumi was back in the group and Garretin (Chanter) took Pantsu’s spot.
Boss 2301008 died on the first try in 232 s, at 410k raid DPS.
In the next run (01:38, with another group) Rahu died in 324 s at 264k group DPS with only 5 deaths.
